# Recorded Canton DevNet acceptance

These are dated execution records, not a claim that every route is live now. They were extracted unchanged from the acceptance ledger at revision `012c990d106770804f66a2119870b6ca3e6b671e`. Times are UTC. The first-call driver ran against Noders DevNet on 6 October 2026; the Canton Coin round trip ran on 7 October. Update IDs identify participant ledger updates; they are not public block-explorer links.

The source ledger, including the earlier attempts and failures, remains available in [Git history](https://github.com/Blockchain-Oracle/owarine/blob/012c990d106770804f66a2119870b6ca3e6b671e/docs/plan/acceptance.md). The [capability inventory](capabilities.json) retains all 219 entries and their original states; historical evidence references are validated with `git cat-file` rather than relying on ignored local files.
